findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the walk over the exception __cause__ chain, so a circular chain now loops forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the raised exception has a cyclic __cause__ chain (for example a.__cause__ = b and b.__cause__ = a, or e.__cause__ = e) and no exception in the cycle matches exception_cause_types. Mechanism: the while loop at line 180 never reaches None and the seen set that previously stopped revisits is gone, so each iteration repeats the same objects indefinitely. Impact: the retry predicate hangs the calling thread instead of returning, which stalls the program.
